qa_pairs.question: What component is identified as number 1 on the discharging and charging station?
qa_pairs.answer: Number 1 is the Pull-out carrying handle.

qa_pairs.question: What are the three different types of charging hoses shown in the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The three charging hoses are: blue hose for "low pressure" (14), red hose for "high pressure" (15), and white charging hose (16).

qa_pairs.question: Which components are used for pressure measurement on this charging station?
qa_pairs.answer: The pressure measurement components are the low pressure gage (3), pressure gage "charging pressure" (20), and pressure gage "high pressure" (21).

qa_pairs.question: What is component number 11 in the discharging and charging station?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 11 is the Vacuum pump.

qa_pairs.question: What type of valves are used for controlling different pressures in the system?
qa_pairs.answer: The system uses several valves including: vacuum valve (4), charging valve "low pressure" (5), shut-off valve (6), gas ballast valve (8), shut-off valve for compressor oil (10), and Schrader valve (19).

qa_pairs.question: Where is the volume scale located on the charging station?
qa_pairs.answer: The volume scale is component number 18, located on the upper right portion of the charging station.

qa_pairs.question: What components are used for different types of charging operations?
qa_pairs.answer: For charging operations, the station has charging valve "gas" (22), charging valve "high pressure" (23), charging valve "liquid" (24), charging valve "refrigerant" (25), and charging cylinder (26).

qa_pairs.question: What is the purpose of component 17 shown at the bottom of the station?
qa_pairs.answer: Component 17 is the Power cord for the discharging and charging station.
